posts.title: The Valley bubble
posts.description: I expected something to happen around the AI hype after the US elections. I didn’t expect it to happen so soon . Too early to tell yaddah yaddah, and the hype could very well continue for another few months, but did any AI-related stock ever tumble before now? Silicon Valley exists in its own reality bubble.
